slides.headline: Their *last* evening together. She won't look up.
The night before a long voyage, on the deck of a *ship*.
The young officer leans close, his head on his *hand*.
She won't look up. Her eyes stay *down*.
Her fingers touch her lips, as if holding back *words*.
Behind them, two older men talk, very *close*.
The old man in the top hat glances at the *couple*.
A little girl peeks over the bench, *curious*.
The captain holds a paper. Maybe the sailing *orders*.
A tartan rug against the cold *evening* air.
All around, masts and ropes wait for *morning*.
Tomorrow they part. Will she *wait* for him?
